    Guides

    • BPC-157 vs TB-500: status, evidence, prices

    TB-500 on prescription

    On 30 Oct 2026 the US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) said it does not intend to act against licensed pharmacies that compound TB-500 for one patient on a prescription, under 10 conditions. That is not FDA approval, and research-use vials are still not approved for use in people. Source For TB-500 it covers these routes: injection under the skin or into a muscle. No online clinic plan we track carries it yet. Our guide Is BPC-157 legal? lists the ten conditions.
